title: Faithfulness of universal Burau representations
statement: Determine the ranks \(n\) for which the Burau representation over \(\mathbb Z[t,t^{-1}]\) is faithful.
status: As of 12 November 2026, faithful for \(n\le3\), unfaithful for \(n\ge5\). A July 2026 preprint, revised September 2026, claims faithfulness for \(n=4\); its main theorem was read but not independently checked here.

title: Three- and four-dimensional reduced planar gauge models
statement: For a specified one-site unitary plaquette model, determine its nonperturbative planar free energy and Wilson loops, with the center-symmetry conditions needed for volume reduction made explicit.
status: As of 12 November 2026 the general all-coupling planar solution is unavailable in the sources checked; exact two-dimensional reductions and higher-dimensional numerical methods are established. Unconditional equivalence of the original untwisted model with four-dimensional weak-coupling gauge theory is false.

title: Commuting quantizations of local KdV Hamiltonians
statement: Construct commuting normally ordered deformations of the complete family of classical local KdV integrals.
status: As of 12 November 2026 solved as an algebraic/formal and generic-parameter construction; spectral classification and exceptional representation specializations are distinct questions.

title: Quantum KdV spectrum in irreducible Virasoro representations
statement: For fixed central charge and highest weight, determine the joint spectral and Jordan data of the commuting quantum KdV charges on the irreducible highest-weight module.
status: As of 12 November 2026 partly solved, with explicit constructions and special-regime results. The opened 2026 Masoero--Ruzza v1 proves a particular c=-2 admissible-QQ completeness statement for nonintegral momentum; it is not an arbitrary-parameter theorem. The chapter provides a checked level-two Jordan obstruction in a nonunitary irreducible quotient.

title: Quantization of second Adler--Gelfand--Dickey structures
statement: Construct a quantum algebra deforming the second Gelfand--Dickey bracket on monic scalar operators of arbitrary order, in the principal Drinfeld--Sokolov setting.
status: As of 12 November 2026 the quantum W-algebra/BRST construction resolves the algebraic problem, with precise generic-parameter identifications in the cited sources.

title: Finite equational basis for subspace-lattice identities
statement: Do identities valid in subspace lattices of all finite-dimensional rational vector spaces follow from finitely many lattice identities? This is the explicit equational reading of the notebook question about linear equivalence.
status: As of 12 November 2026 the stated rational formulation and the analogous all-field variety have a negative answer by Herrmann (1984), Theorem 1.4. The field and type of axioms were not stated in the notebook; the decidability problem GP-1985-20 is different.

title: Preprojective reduction of the free modular lattice
statement: Describe the quotient of \(D^r\) by equality in all indecomposable preprojective rational representations and characterize its represented subspace families.
status: As of 12 November 2026 the 1987 Gelfand--Lidskii--Ponomarev theorem gives a precise large-rank answer through compatible eventually generated families and graded right ideals. The present chapter uses the safely verified subrange r>=7; it does not turn the historical r=5 exception into a present-day open claim.
